title: Tor bound on the reduced pro-etale Verdier dual
statement: Fix the finite-field datum D, a prime l distinct from its characteristic, a finite extension E of Q_l, a separated finite-type scheme X over its algebraic closure and dim X <= d for d in N [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism]. At positive levels n+1 >= m+1 use the actual coefficient quotient and scalar extension S, and the pro-etale dualizing object W_n obtained by comparison pullback from the counit-defined etale omega_n [lem-coef-finite-dualizing, lem-weil-finite-duality-site-comparison]. Let K be finite-Tor constructible in the fixed ModuleCat pro-etale presentation [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude] and have ordered Tor interval [a,b] [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude]. Then S(RHom(K,W_n)), after the published fixed-module intrinsic realization, has Tor interval [-b-2d,-a] over level m+1. This statement only concerns the left endpoint, and asserts no Hom comparison or equations for it.

proof.text: Choose an etale finite-Tor constructible representative Kprime of K with the same [a,b] interval, using site descent and the fixed-module intrinsic realization equivalence. Evaluation-defined site Hom comparison identifies the pro-etale dual with pullback of the etale dual of Kprime, for the specified transported target.

proof.text: Verdier preservation bounds the etale dual by [-b-2d,-a] and makes it constructible. This interval is ordered since a<=b and d>=0. The bounded flat constructible K-flat model stays in the interval after the coefficient quotient, by the flat-model scalar-extension theorem.

proof.text: The scalar/site isomorphism identifies scalar extension of the pro-etale dual with comparison pullback of that reduced etale dual. Site descent preserves its Tor interval. Transport through these isomorphisms and the intrinsic realization gives the required HasProEtaleTorAmplitude predicate, testing all degree-zero module sheaves. This also handles zero objects, the empty scheme and identity quotients.

theorem finiteVerdier_proEtale_left_tor
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (d : ℕ) (X : Scheme.{u})
    (hd : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞))
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    {n m : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n)
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (finiteDualizingCoeff l E n))))
    (hK : finiteTorConstructibleProEtaleModule l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n) X K)
    (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (ht : Scheme.HasProEtaleTorAmplitude X (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))
      ((ProEtale.finiteCoefficientIntrinsicRealization X
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) a b) :
    Scheme.HasProEtaleTorAmplitude X (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (m + 1))
      ((ProEtale.finiteCoefficientIntrinsicRealization X
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (m + 1))).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((pbcFixedScalarExtension (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
          (finiteDualizingQuotient l E h)).obj
          (((finiteVerdierProEtaleHomAt (finiteDualizingCoeff l E n) X).obj (op K)).obj
            ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (finiteDualizingCoeff l E n))
              X).mapDerivedCategory.obj (finiteDualizingEtaleTerm l E D X n)))))
      (-b - 2 * (d : ℤ)) (-a)
